# References {.unnumbered}

The following sources are cited by chapter or used as Further Reading. Links were current when the draft was prepared; verify a source before relying on it for a release decision.

## Standards and primary references

- ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018, *Systems and software engineering — Life cycle processes — Requirements engineering*. <https://www.iso.org/standard/72089.html>
- CommonMark, *CommonMark Spec*. <https://spec.commonmark.org/>
- Creative Commons, *Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International*. <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/>
- SPDX, *License List*. <https://spdx.org/licenses/>
